intervals.label: collaboration
intervals.note: True formation date not sourced; start is a lower bound taken from the start of MINERvA data taking in early 2010 (the collaboration must have existed by then). Detector data taking ended 26 Feb 2019 (status 'completed' on the experiment entity), but the collaboration continued to publish analyses of the recorded data, e.g. the 2023 Nature paper; left 'active' since no dissolution is sourced.
intervals.quote: MINERvA started collecting data in early 2010.

summary.plain: The team that built and ran the MINERvA neutrino-nucleus cross-section experiment at Fermilab, and continues to publish analyses of its data.
summary.technical: Collaboration operating the MINERvA fine-grained scintillator tracker in the NuMI near-detector hall at Fermilab; data taking 2010-2019, with continued publication of cross-section analyses afterward.
